description: This file contains unit tests for the HpackVarintDecoder class, testing variable-length integer encoding/decoding in HTTP/2 HPACK header compression, including encoding validation and boundary cases.

classes.name: HpackVarintRoundTripTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing HPACK variable-length integer encoding/decoding.

methods.name: HiValueOfExtensionBytes
methods.description: Calculates the highest value with a given number of extension bytes and prefix length.

methods.name: StartDecoding
methods.description: Initial decoding step, reads prefix byte and starts decoder.

methods.name: DecodeSeveralWays
methods.description: Validates decoding correctness across different segmentations.

methods.name: EncodeNoRandom
methods.description: Encodes a value with specified prefix length without random bits.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes a value with random bits added to the prefix.

methods.name: ValidateEncoding
methods.description: Validates the encoding of a value against expected byte patterns.

methods.name: EncodeAndDecodeValues
methods.description: Encodes a set of values and tests decoding correctness.

methods.name: EncodeAndDecodeValuesInRange
methods.description: Encodes and tests decoding of a range of values.
